# Linework: Trace & Sketch

> Linework shows a photo or template over your phone's live camera view so you can trace it onto real paper with your own pencil, or use the screen as a lightbox. Free download. Tracing your own photos with every tracing tool stays free; Linework Plus is a one-time A$2.99 for the full template library and photo-to-outline.
